summary.text: Bant is one of the five shards of Alara, a primarily white-aligned haven of order, honor and community ruled by knights and guarded by angels.

bio.text: A council of archmages long ago enchanted Bant so that mortals who die conforming to its ideals reform as angels.
After Alara split into shards, Bant's martial traditions became ceremonial and ritualized, and its nations Jhess and Valeron were at war.
The archangel Asha, Bant's ruler, gave her life fighting the demon Malfegor, and no angel took her title.
During the Conflux, red and black mana flooded into Bant and the Order of the Skyward Eye sowed mistrust, and Bant's nations forgot their war to unite against a common threat.
Creatures from Grixis and Jund slaughtered settlements and its angels lost control as society collapsed.
Elspeth, who had adopted Bant as her home, helped Rafiq kill Malfegor, and Bant's borders then merged with the other shards until it became part of New Alara and its castles lay in ruin.
In the New Phyrexian Invasion, Alara was struck at Bant, Esper and Jund.

status.text: Bant no longer exists as a separate shard, since it became part of New Alara, and it was later struck in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
